jobs.title: Regional Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Lieu : Est de la Suisse romande — cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais

Taux d’activité : Temps plein, 100%

Type de Contract : Contrat à durée indéterminée

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

• Identifier et concrétiser les opportunités d’acquisition de nouveaux clients, en élaborant des offres Food & Beverages adaptées à leurs besoins.

• Piloter les négociations contractuelles jusqu’à la conclusion des accords, en assurant l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux.

• Décliner et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de vente nationale au niveau régional, en l’adaptant au contexte local et aux spécificités des clients clés.

• Suivre, analyser et piloter la performance des clients à l’aide d’indicateurs clés, et définir des plans d’action structurés afin d’atteindre, voire dépasser, les objectifs fixés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes internes.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Expérience réussie dans la vente au sein du secteur HORECA, idéalement dans les domaines du café, des boissons ou des produits culinaires.

• Excellent sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’allemand indispensable; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, flexibilité et forte orientation client.

Chez Nestlé Professional, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir un environnement de travail qui favorise votre développement professionnel, votre bien-être et votre équilibre de vie:

• Des modalités de travail flexibles adaptées aux exigences du poste.

• Des congés supérieurs aux dispositions légales.

• De nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement professionnel.

• Un système de rémunération variable lié à la performance.

• Une participation aux frais de santé ainsi qu'un programme d'assistance aux collaborateurs.

• Une contribution attractive à votre prévoyance professionnelle.

• Des congés parentaux généreux et des solutions de soutien aux familles.

• Des réductions avantageuses sur une large gamme de produits et services.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement inclusif et stimulant, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement et de collaboration à travers les différentes activités de Nestlé.

Comment se déroule notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier durant le processus, nous serons heureux de vous accompagner.

Le processus comprend généralement un entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition, un entretien avec le manager recruteur et les parties prenantes concernées, suivi d’une discussion finale et d’une proposition d’embauche. Les candidatures sont examinées au fil de leur réception ; nous vous encourageons donc à postuler rapidement.

Restez vigilant(e) : Nestlé ne contactera les candidats qu’à partir d’adresses e-mail officielles de l’entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiement ou d’informations bancaires dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.

Luogo: Est della Svizzera romanda — cantoni di Vaud, Friburgo e Vallese

Percentuale di impiego: Tempo pieno, 100%

Tipo di contratto: Contratto a tempo indeterminato

Sii una forza positiva e accelera il cambiamento che migliora la vita delle persone e del pianeta.

In Nestlé Professional, supportiamo i professionisti della ristorazione con soluzioni di alto livello per il caffè e la cucina, consentendo agli appassionati di gastronomia in tutta la Svizzera di gustare prodotti di alta qualità grazie a marchi iconici come STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® e CHEF®.

In qualità di Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages, entrerai a far parte di un team esperto e motivato. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo di account strategici nell'Est della Svizzera romanda, identificando nuove opportunità commerciali, elaborando strategie di crescita e creando partnership durature con i tuoi clienti.

In qualità di vero partner di fiducia, sarai l'interlocutore privilegiato dei tuoi clienti e contribuirai attivamente allo sviluppo del tuo portafoglio, conciliando l'acquisizione di nuovi account, la fidelizzazione dei clienti esistenti e il raggiungimento sostenibile degli obiettivi commerciali.

Il tuo impatto in qualità di Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

- Sviluppare e mantenere solide relazioni di partnership con i clienti, fungendo da interlocutore privilegiato e garantendo la loro soddisfazione a lungo termine.
- Identificare e concretizzare le opportunità di acquisizione di nuovi clienti, elaborando offerte Food & Beverages adeguate alle loro esigenze.
- Gestire le negoziazioni contrattuali fino alla conclusione degli accordi, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali.
- Declinare e attuare la strategia di vendita nazionale a livello regionale, adattandola al contesto locale e alle specificità dei clienti chiave.
- Monitorare, analizzare e gestire le performance dei clienti mediante indicatori chiave, e definire piani d'azione strutturati al fine di raggiungere, o persino superare, gli obiettivi prefissati.
- Collaborare a stretto contatto con i diversi team interni.

Ciò che ti porterà al successo

- Esperienza comprovata nella vendita nel settore HORECA, idealmente nei settori del caffè, delle bevande o dei prodotti culinari.
- Eccellenti capacità di negoziazione e forte orientamento ai risultati.
- La padronanza del francese e del tedesco è indispensabile; l'inglese costituisce un vantaggio.
- Autonomia, spirito d'iniziativa, flessibilità e forte orientamento al cliente.

In Nestlé Professional, le persone sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

Facciamo tutto il possibile per offrire un ambiente di lavoro che favorisca il tuo sviluppo professionale, il tuo benessere e il tuo equilibrio tra vita professionale e privata:

- Modalità di lavoro flessibili adattate alle esigenze del ruolo.
- Ferie superiori a quelle previste dalla legge.
- Numerose opportunità di formazione e sviluppo professionale.
- Un sistema di retribuzione variabile legato alle prestazioni.
- Un contributo alle spese sanitarie e un programma di assistenza ai collaboratori.
- Un contributo interessante alla vostra previdenza professionale.
- Congedi parentali generosi e soluzioni di sostegno alle famiglie.
- Riduzioni vantaggiose su un'ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi.

Lavorerete in un ambiente inclusivo e stimolante, che offre numerose opportunità di sviluppo e collaborazione attraverso le diverse attività di Nestlé.

Come si svolge il nostro processo di selezione

Ci impegniamo a offrire un'esperienza di selezione inclusiva e rispettosa. Se avete bisogno di un adeguamento specifico durante il processo, saremo lieti di supportarvi.

Il processo comprende generalmente un colloquio con il team Talent Acquisition, un colloquio con il responsabile delle assunzioni e le parti interessate coinvolte, seguito da una discussione finale e da una proposta di assunzione. Le candidature vengono esaminate man mano che vengono ricevute; vi incoraggiamo quindi a candidarvi rapidamente.

Fate attenzione: Nestlé contatterà i candidati esclusivamente da indirizzi e-mail aziendali ufficiali e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni bancarie nell'ambito del processo di selezione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Eastern French-speaking Switzerland — cantons of Vaud, Fribourg and Valais

Employment rate: Full-time, 100%

Contract Type: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and That change thatIows lives and the planet.

At Nestlé Professional, we support foodservice professionals with leading coffee and culinary solutions, enabling food enthusiasts throughout Switzerland to enjoy high-quality products through iconic brands such as STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® and CHEF®.

As a Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages, you will join an experienced and committed team. You will play a key role in developing strategic accounts in eastern French-speaking Switzerland, identifying new business opportunities, developing growth strategies and creating lasting partnerships with your clients.

As a trusted partner, you will be your clients’ preferred point of contact and will actively contribute to the development of your portfolio by balancing the acquisition of new accounts, the retention of existing clients and the sustainable achievement of business objectives.

Your impact as a Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

- Develop and maintain strong partnerships with clients, acting as their preferred point of contact and ensuring their long-term satisfaction.
- Identify and convert opportunities to acquire new clients by developing Food & Beverages offerings tailored to their needs.
- Lead contract negotiations through to the conclusion of agreements, ensuring that sales objectives are met.
- Roll out and implement the national sales strategy at the regional level, adapting it to the local context and the specific needs of key clients.
- Monitor, analyze and manage customer performance using key performance indicators, and define structured action plans to achieve, or even exceed, the objectives set.
- Work closely with the various internal teams.

What will make you successful

- Proven sales experience in the HORECA sector, ideally in coffee, beverages or culinary products.
- Excellent negotiation skills and a strong results orientation.
- Proficiency in French and German is essential; English is an asset.
- Autonomy, initiative, flexibility and a strong customer focus.

At Nestlé Professional, people are at the heart of everything we do.

We do everything we can to provide a work environment that supports your professional development, well-being and work-life balance:

- Flexible working arrangements tailored to the requirements of the position.
- More leave than required by law.
- Numerous training and professional development opportunities.
- A variable compensation system linked to performance.
- A contribution toward healthcare costs, as well as an employee assistance program.
- An attractive contribution to your occupational pension plan.
- Generous parental leave and family support solutions.
- Attractive discounts on a wide range of products and services.

You will work in an inclusive and stimulating environment, offering numerous opportunities for development and collaboration across Nestlé's different activities.

How our recruitment process works

We are committed to offering an inclusive and respectful recruitment experience. If you need any particular accommodation during the process, we will be happy to support you.

The process generally includes an interview with the Talent Acquisition team, an interview with the hiring manager and relevant stakeholders, followed by a final discussion and a job offer. Applications are reviewed as they are received; we therefore encourage you to apply quickly.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates from official company email addresses and will never request payment or banking information as part of the recruitment process.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ort: Östlicher Teil der Westschweiz — Kantone Waadt, Freiburg und Wallis

Beschäftigungsgrad: Vollzeit, 100%

Vertragsart: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.

Bei Nestlé Professional unterstützen wir Gastronomiefachleute mit erstklassigen Kaffee- und kulinarischen Lösungen und ermöglichen Gastronomiebegeisterten in der ganzen Schweiz, dank ikonischer Marken wie STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® und CHEF® hochwertige Produkte zu geniessen.

Als Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages werden Sie Teil eines erfahrenen und engagierten Teams. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung strategischer Kunden im Osten der Westschweiz, indem Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften mit Ihren Kunden aufbauen.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind Sie die bevorzugte Ansprechperson Ihrer Kunden und tragen aktiv zur Entwicklung Ihres Kundenportfolios bei, indem Sie die Akquise neuer Kunden, die Bindung bestehender Kunden und das nachhaltige Erreichen der Vertriebsziele miteinander in Einklang bringen.

Ihr Beitrag als Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

- Starke partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu den Kunden aufbauen und pflegen, als bevorzugte Ansprechperson agieren und deren langfristige Zufriedenheit sicherstellen.
- Möglichkeiten zur Gewinnung neuer Kunden identifizieren und realisieren, indem Sie auf ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Angebote im Bereich Food & Beverages entwickeln.
- Vertragsverhandlungen bis zum Abschluss der Vereinbarungen steuern und dabei die Erreichung der Vertriebsziele sicherstellen.
- Die nationale Vertriebsstrategie auf regionaler Ebene umsetzen und an den lokalen Kontext sowie die Besonderheiten der Schlüsselkunden anpassen.
- Die Leistung der Kunden mithilfe von Kennzahlen verfolgen, analysieren und steuern sowie strukturierte Aktionspläne definieren, um die festgelegten Ziele zu erreichen oder sogar zu übertreffen.
- Eng mit den verschiedenen internen Teams zusammenarbeiten.

Was Ihren Erfolg ausmachen wird

- Erfolgreiche Vertriebserfahrung im HORECA-Sektor, idealerweise in den Bereichen Kaffee, Getränke oder kulinarische Produkte.
- Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und starke Ergebnisorientierung.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Französisch und Deutsch sind unerlässlich; Englisch ist von Vorteil.
- Selbstständigkeit, Eigeninitiative, Flexibilität und ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.

Bei Nestlé Professional stehen die Menschen im Mittelpunkt all dessen, was wir tun.

Wir setzen alles daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das Ihre berufliche Entwicklung, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Work-Life-Balance fördert:

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, die den Anforderungen der Stelle entsprechen.
- Mehr Urlaubstage als gesetzlich vorgeschrieben.
- Zahlreiche Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung.
- Ein variables Vergütungssystem, das an die Leistung gekoppelt ist.
- Eine Beteiligung an den Gesundheitskosten sowie ein Unterstützungsprogramm für Mitarbeitende.
- Ein attraktiver Beitrag zu Ihrer beruflichen Vorsorge.
- Großzügige Elternzeitregelungen und Lösungen zur Unterstützung von Familien.
- Attraktive Rabatte auf eine große Auswahl an Produkten und Dienstleistungen.

Sie werden in einem inklusiven und anregenden Umfeld tätig sein, das zahlreiche Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und Zusammenarbeit in den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen von Nestlé bietet.

Wie läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess ab

Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives und respektvolles Bewerbungserlebnis zu bieten. Wenn Sie während des Prozesses eine besondere Anpassung benötigen, unterstützen wir Sie gerne.

Der Prozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit dem Talent-Acquisition-Team, ein Gespräch mit der einstellenden Führungskraft und den relevanten Stakeholdern, gefolgt von einem abschließenden Gespräch und einem Jobangebot. Bewerbungen werden fortlaufend nach ihrem Eingang geprüft; wir empfehlen Ihnen daher, sich schnell zu bewerben.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Bewerber ausschließlich von offiziellen E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens aus kontaktieren und im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses niemals eine Zahlung oder Bankinformationen verlangen.

jobs.title: Global Medical Communication Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable mondial de la communication médicale

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing substantial medical marketing experience in nutrition, pharmaceuticals or consumer healthcare environments.

• Applying scientific and regulatory awareness, including familiarity with external guidelines and regulations relevant to healthcare professional and advocacy relations to develop credible branded and non-branded healthcare professional programmes and materials.

• Using strategic planning, data analysis and project leadership to move multiple priorities from insight to action, with global experience highly preferred.

• Collaborating with influence and integrity across global teams while building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé Nutrition and Health, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vevey, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta.

In qualità di Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, la vostra missione è quella di plasmare la comunicazione globale e professionale-centro per la vitamina premium, il minerale e il portafoglio di integratori, traducendo l'ultima scienza in convincenti impegni branded e non-branded che supportano nuovi e prodotti esistenti. Farete la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con il marketing, gli affari normativi e scientifici, la scienza della nutrizione, la ricerca e lo sviluppo, le squadre regionali e di mercato, le agenzie esterne, i partner di ricerca e gli esperti scientifici. As a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant at Nestlé Product Technology Centre, your mission will be to maximize the effectiveness of the R&D Centre Head and leadership team by acting as a trusted support partner in a high-exposure position.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant

• Act as a trusted support partner to the NPTC Head and Leadership Team, enabling strategic focus and effective decision-making.

• Manage complex calendars, priorities and schedules, anticipating conflicts and ensuring timely preparation and follow-up.

• Prepare agendas, minutes, action tracking and key documents with accuracy, structure and confidentiality.

• Coordinate collaboration and information flow across Vevey, Konolfingen and other NPTC units.

• Organize leadership meetings, site events and complex workshops, including logistics, content and follow-up.

• Maintain SharePoint and intranet content, ensuring accurate and accessible information.

• Review and enhance presentations, documents and leadership communications for clarity and impact.

• Handle sensitive information with sound judgment, professionalism and discretion.

• Support newcomer onboarding and communication to help them navigate the organization.

• Provide autonomous support on audits, reporting, follow-ups and ad hoc operational priorities.

• Solid experience in a senior administrative, executive assistant, coordination or project support role within an international, matrixed and fast-moving organization.

• Strong ability to manage complexity, anticipate needs, prioritize competing demands and keep senior stakeholders aligned and informed.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams, with confidence in preparing high-quality documents, presentations and simple data follow-ups.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt messages for different senior stakeholders; French and/or German would be an asset in this multi-site environment.

jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

In dieser Funktion stellen Sie Nestlé Waters die 18-monatige beste Schätzung der Kundennachfrage zur Verfügung und verbessern die Genauigkeit des Bedarfsplans. Darüber hinaus verwalten Sie die Lieferung von Fertigprodukten in verschiedenen Lagerhallen und verwalten die von Co-Packern produzierten Fertigwaren. Das Hauptziel wird es sein, die Reaktionsfähigkeit der Lieferkette bei der Erfüllung der Kundennachfrage zu optimalen Kosten zu verbessern.

Ein Tag im Leben eines Demand & Supply Planers:

• Sicherstellen der Lieferung und Verfügbarkeit von Produkten, um die Lieferungen pünktlich am richtigen Ort mit der richtigen Frische auf Lagerebene zu erfüllen

• Verwenden Sie geeignete statistische Modelle und Parameter, interpretieren Sie die Ergebnisse, um genaue Basisnachfrageprognosen zu erstellen

• Schnelle, angemessene Maßnahmen zur Minimierung der Auswirkungen von Abweichungen vom Bedarfsplan und Kommunikation der umgesetzten Maßnahmen an die Stakeholder

• Erfassung, Priorisierung, Analyse und Eingabe Generierung von Nachfrageereignissen; Kunden-, Verbraucher- und Wettbewerberinformationen

• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung einer guten Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit sowohl in der Lieferkette als auch bei der Generierung von Nachfrage, Fertigung, Qualität und Finanzen, um unsere Kunden zu optimalen Kosten zu liefern und zufrieden zu stellen

• Unterstützen Sie verschiedene Prozesse innerhalb der Supply Chain

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten

• Fließend in Französisch & Englisch alle anderen Sprachen ist ein Plus

• Gute Excel- und SAP-Erfahrung

Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez à Nestlé Waters la meilleure estimation de la demande des clients sur 18 mois et améliorerez la précision du plan de demande. De plus, vous gérerez l'approvisionnement en produits finis dans différents entrepôts et les produits finis produits par les co-emballeurs. L'objectif principal sera d'améliorer la réactivité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en répondant à la demande des clients à un coût optimal.

Une journée dans une vie de planificateur de demande et d'offre :

• Assurer l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des produits pour effectuer les livraisons à temps, au bon endroit avec la fraîcheur correcte au niveau de l'entrepôt

• Utiliser des modèles et paramètres statistiques appropriés, interpréter les résultats pour générer des prévisions précises de la demande de base

• Conduire des mesures rapides et appropriées pour minimiser l'impact des écarts par rapport au plan de demande et communiquer les mesures mises en oeuvre aux intervenants

• Capturer, prioriser, analyser et input Générer des événements de demande; renseignements sur les clients, les consommateurs et les concurrents

• Fournir régulièrement aux équipes de production de la demande des intrants concernant les lancements de produits, l'optimisation du portefeuille, la justification des décisions commerciales, les promotions et le comportement des clients

• Construisez et maintenez une bonne communication et collaboration au sein de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de la production de la demande, de la fabrication, de la qualité et des finances, afin de fournir et de satisfaire nos clients à des coûts optimaux

• Soutenir différents processus au sein de la chaîne d'approvisionnement

Ce qui vous fait réussir:

• Diplôme universitaire avec des stages antérieurs effectués idéalement dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou le CFC commercial avec maturité ou niveau équivalent avec au moins deux ans d'expérience dans une position similaire ou une expérience opérationnelle pertinente dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement au niveau du marché / entreprise

• Bonnes compétences en communication et collaboration pour traiter avec différents départements (Marketing, Usine, Transport)
